metadata.description: Vedic astrological remedies for the Navagrahas (9 Grahas) synthesized from classical Jyotish and live astrology MCP services.

Sun.wear_time: Within 1 hour after sunrise during Shukla Paksha (waxing moon)
Sun.mantra: Om Hram Hreem Hroum Sah Suryaya Namah

vedic_mantras.beej_mantra: Om Hram Hreem Hroum Sah Suryaya Namah
vedic_mantras.gayatri_mantra: Om Bhaskaray Vidmahe Divakaraya Dhimahi Tanno Suryah Prachodayat

rudraksha_details.significance: Lord Surya and Lord Shiva; increases self-power, leadership, clarity of purpose, and vitality.

Sun.charity_recipients: Father figures, Vedic scholars, temple priests, or needy persons
Sun.fasting_rules: Fast from sunrise; consume one salt-free meal made of wheat, milk, or sweet porridge (kheer) after midday or sunset; avoid heavy spices.
Sun.positive_lifestyle_action: Practice Surya Namaskar at dawn, cultivate respectful relationships with fatherly figures, lead with integrity, and spend 15 minutes in natural morning sunlight.
positive_lifestyle_actions: Perform Surya Namaskar (Sun Salutations) outdoors facing east at dawn.
Express gratitude and maintain respectful, caring relationships with your father and elder mentors.
Cultivate transparent, courageous leadership with humility and dignity.
Spend 15-20 minutes daily in morning natural sunlight to boost vitality and vitamin D synthesis.

Moon.wear_finger: Little Finger or Ring Finger (Kanishtha / Anamika)
Moon.wear_time: Monday evening during moonrise or Shukla Paksha Monday morning
Moon.mantra: Om Shram Shreem Shroum Sah Chandraya Namah

vedic_mantras.beej_mantra: Om Shram Shreem Shroum Sah Chandraya Namah
vedic_mantras.gayatri_mantra: Om Ksheeraputraya Vidmahe Amritatvaya Dhimahi Tanno Chandrah Prachodayat

Moon.deity: Goddess Parvati / Lord Shiva / Chandra Dev

rudraksha_details.significance: Ardhanarishwara; balances mind, emotional stability, harmony in relationships, and inner calm.

Moon.charity_recipients: Mother figures, elderly women, nurses, or drought/water relief initiatives
Moon.fasting_rules: Fast sunrise to moonrise on Mondays; break fast after offering water (arghya) to the Moon with satvik white foods like milk or kheer without salt.
Moon.positive_lifestyle_action: Practice calming pranayama (Anulom Vilom), honor your mother, maintain emotional journaling, and stay well hydrated.
positive_lifestyle_actions: Practice alternate nostril breathing (Anulom Vilom) to stabilize fluctuating emotions.
Deepen respectful, affectionate bonding with mother figures and women.
Drink clean water from a silver cup; take mindful walks near natural water bodies.
Foster emotional mindfulness and avoid brooding over past regrets.

Mars.wear_time: Tuesday morning within 1 hour after sunrise during Shukla Paksha
Mars.mantra: Om Kram Kreem Kroum Sah Bhaumaya Namah

vedic_mantras.beej_mantra: Om Kram Kreem Kroum Sah Bhaumaya Namah
vedic_mantras.gayatri_mantra: Om Angarkaya Vidmahe Bhoomipalaya Dhimahi Tanno Bhaumah Prachodayat

rudraksha_details.significance: Agni Dev; purifies past guilt, ignites courageous vitality, and overcomes laziness and blood impurities.

Mars.charity_recipients: Brothers, soldiers, uniformed service personnel, or blood banks
Mars.fasting_rules: Fast on Tuesdays from sunrise to sunset; partake in a single salt-free meal prepared with wheat flour, jaggery, or red lentils in the evening.
Mars.positive_lifestyle_action: Channel intense energy into disciplined athletics or strength training, practice non-violence and patience, and protect younger siblings.
positive_lifestyle_actions: Channel vigor into daily cardiovascular or resistance physical training.
Recite Hanuman Chalisa for emotional resilience and fearlessness.
Practice a 5-second pause before responding when angry to prevent impulsive outbursts.
Support younger brothers, comrades, and stand up courageously for vulnerable people.

Mercury.wear_time: Wednesday morning within 2 hours after sunrise during Shukla Paksha
Mercury.mantra: Om Bram Breem Broum Sah Budhaya Namah

vedic_mantras.beej_mantra: Om Bram Breem Broum Sah Budhaya Namah
vedic_mantras.gayatri_mantra: Om Gajadhwajaya Vidmahe Sukhahastaya Dhimahi Tanno Budhah Prachodayat

rudraksha_details.significance: Lord Brahma (4 Mukhi) and Lord Vishnu (10 Mukhi); enhances memory, articulation, intellectual dexterity, and business acumen.

Mercury.charity_recipients: Students, schools, libraries, or speech/intellectually challenged persons
Mercury.fasting_rules: Fast on Wednesdays from sunrise to sunset; eat a single meal made of green moong or green fruits; abstain from deceitful talk.
Mercury.positive_lifestyle_action: Read stimulating literature, practice articulate and truthful communication, solve analytical puzzles, and keep organized accounts.
positive_lifestyle_actions: Dedicate 30 minutes daily to reading, writing, or learning a new language/skill.
Practice conscious, honest, and diplomatic communication without gossip.
Keep financial accounts and workspaces meticulously organized.
Feed green grass to cows or care for indoor green houseplants.

Jupiter.wear_time: Thursday morning during Jupiter hora / sunrise during Shukla Paksha
Jupiter.mantra: Om Gram Greem Groum Sah Gurave Namah

vedic_mantras.beej_mantra: Om Gram Greem Groum Sah Gurave Namah
vedic_mantras.gayatri_mantra: Om Vrishabadhwajaya Vidmahe Krunihastaya Dhimahi Tanno Guruh Prachodayat

Jupiter.deity: Lord Brihaspati / Lord Vishnu / Lord Dakshinamurthy

rudraksha_details.significance: Kalagni Rudra; confers spiritual wisdom, good fortune, broad-mindedness, and protects against untimely misfortunes.

Jupiter.charity_recipients: Teachers, professors, spiritual mentors, Brahmins, or orphanage education funds
Jupiter.fasting_rules: Fast on Thursdays; avoid washing hair/clothes; consume one yellow salt-free meal made of chana dal or besan with turmeric once a day.
Jupiter.positive_lifestyle_action: Pursue lifelong wisdom, mentor others with generosity, honor teachers, and maintain optimistic ethical standards.
positive_lifestyle_actions: Engage in regular philosophical and moral reflection to broaden worldview.
Show genuine veneration to teachers, professors, and spiritual mentors.
Actively mentor junior colleagues or underprivileged students.
Water and venerate a Peepal or Banana tree on Thursday mornings.

Venus.wear_time: Friday morning at sunrise during Shukla Paksha
Venus.mantra: Om Dram Dreem Droum Sah Shukraya Namah

vedic_mantras.beej_mantra: Om Dram Dreem Droum Sah Shukraya Namah
vedic_mantras.gayatri_mantra: Om Rajadabhadraya Vidmahe Bhrigukanyaya Dhimahi Tanno Shukrah Prachodayat

rudraksha_details.significance: Enhances charisma, artistic expression, marital contentment, and refined emotional sensitivity.

Venus.charity_recipients: Artists, underprivileged women, young girls, or women empowerment shelters
Venus.fasting_rules: Fast on Fridays from sunrise to sunset; break fast after worshipping Goddess Lakshmi with white sweet milk porridge (kheer) without sour substances.
Venus.positive_lifestyle_action: Express creativity through music, visual arts, or refined writing; cultivate clean aesthetics; honor marital and romantic partners.
positive_lifestyle_actions: Express aesthetic creativity through art, music, architecture, or interior design.
Treat life partner and women with unconditional courtesy and dignity.
Practice personal grooming, cleanliness, and wear pleasant natural scents.
Maintain moderation in sensory pleasures to avoid dissipation of vital energy.

Saturn.wear_time: Saturday evening during twilight or Saturday sunrise during Shukla Paksha
Saturn.mantra: Om Pram Preem Proum Sah Shanaishcharaya Namah

vedic_mantras.beej_mantra: Om Pram Preem Proum Sah Shanaishcharaya Namah
vedic_mantras.gayatri_mantra: Om Kakadhwajaya Vidmahe Khadgahastaya Dhimahi Tanno Mandah Prachodayat

Saturn.deity: Lord Shani / Lord Hanuman / Lord Shiva

rudraksha_details.significance: Mitigates Sadhe Sati and Saturn afflictions, fosters financial stability, perseverance, and emotional fortitude.

Saturn.charity_recipients: Manual laborers, sanitation workers, elderly caretakers, and destitute persons
Saturn.fasting_rules: Fast on Saturdays from sunrise to sunset; perform Chhaya Daan (see face in bowl of mustard oil and donate); break fast with sesame or khichdi.
Saturn.positive_lifestyle_action: Practice stoic patience, respect laborers and cleaners, embrace long-term discipline, and serve elderly parents.
positive_lifestyle_actions: Cultivate patient perseverance: treat obstacles as character-building crucibles.
Treat domestic workers, sanitation workers, and manual laborers with warmth and fair compensation.
Light a mustard oil lamp under a Peepal tree on Saturday evenings.
Maintain punctuality, avoid procrastination, and embrace humble selfless service (seva).

Rahu.wear_time: Saturday twilight or during Rahu Kalam on Saturday evening
Rahu.mantra: Om Bhram Bhreem Bhroum Sah Rahave Namah

vedic_mantras.beej_mantra: Om Bhram Bhreem Bhroum Sah Rahave Namah
vedic_mantras.gayatri_mantra: Om Nagadhwajaya Vidmahe Padmahastaya Dhimahi Tanno Rahuh Prachodayat

Rahu.deity: Goddess Durga / Lord Bhairava / Goddess Saraswati

rudraksha_details.significance: Removes hurdles and hidden obstacles, dispels illusions, clears mental confusion, and insulates against deception.

Rahu.charity_recipients: Lepers, street cleaners, sweepers, or stray dog rescue shelters
Rahu.fasting_rules: Fast on Saturdays until sunset; avoid tobacco/alcohol; recite Durga Saptashati or Rahu Stotram; break fast with satvik khichdi.
Rahu.positive_lifestyle_action: Clear physical and digital clutter, ground thinking through meditation, avoid speculative gambling, and maintain strict sleep hygiene.
positive_lifestyle_actions: Declutter electronic gadgets, old cables, and unorganized storage spaces.
Practice regular digital detox periods to counter mental illusions and info-overload.
Avoid high-risk financial speculation, get-rich-quick schemes, and deceptive practices.
Feed stray dogs and birds daily with whole grain bread or biscuits.

Ketu.wear_time: Tuesday or Thursday morning at dawn during Shukla Paksha
Ketu.mantra: Om Stram Streem Stroum Sah Ketave Namah

vedic_mantras.beej_mantra: Om Stram Streem Stroum Sah Ketave Namah
vedic_mantras.gayatri_mantra: Om Ashwadhwajaya Vidmahe Shoolahastaya Dhimahi Tanno Ketuh Prachodayat

Ketu.deity: Lord Ganesha / Matsya Avatar / Goddess Durga

rudraksha_details.significance: Enhances self-power, spiritual awakening, concentration, non-fear, and sharp intuitive insight while calming the nervous system.

Ketu.charity_recipients: Monks, ascetic spiritual seekers, ashrams, or shelter for abandoned animals
Ketu.fasting_rules: Fast on Tuesdays or Thursdays; offer worship and Modak to Lord Ganesha; break fast after dusk with fruits or simple satvik porridge.
Ketu.positive_lifestyle_action: Cultivate non-attachment to material status, practice silent meditation (Vipassana), support spiritual pilgrimages, and care for stray animals.
positive_lifestyle_actions: Practice Vipassana or silent mindfulness meditation to hone inner intuition.
Foster philosophical non-attachment to transient material praises or losses.
Feed black-and-white stray dogs and care for injured animals.
Donate educational or medical assistance to disabled or underprivileged spiritual seekers.
